test_keep_alive_argument: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on function arguments to verify child object lifetime
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on return values to verify child object lifetime
test_alive_gc: test garbage collection behavior with circular references and keep_alive policies in pybind11
test_keep_alive_constructor: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on constructors to verify parent-child object lifetime
test_call_guard: test pybind11 call_guard policies including GIL handling and multiple guard ordering
